messages:
maya: FYI — running into a nasty edge with our sampleapp when rotating project-scoped API keys.
jordan: quick repro?
maya: steps: create project key in console, set REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT in .env, start sampleapp, then rotate the project key in console. after ~2 mins requests start failing 401/403.
maya: SDK logs show it initially reads env as REDWOOD_API_KEY (no PROJECT mention); later it silently starts using org key fallback.
sam: silent switch to org key is concerning. Is the app caching tokens?
maya: yes — Node SDK getCredential() order is REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT. project key ends up last. so rotation of the project key can leave the process with stale cached token or the wrong scope.
jordan: that contradicts what CLI shows (rw auth whoami reports project key when REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT present). parity gap between CLI and SDK.
lee: 1) CLI precedence != SDK precedence 2) long-running processes don't refresh on token_invalid. both need fixes.
sam: proposed fixes: prefer explicit *_PROJECT env var when present (or add REDWOOD_CREDENTIAL_PRIORITY env), and implement refresh-on-401/token_invalid to re-read env/cached creds.
jordan: also add a conspicuous log line whenever we switch credential source (env->cache->fallback) so devs can debug.
maya: temporary workaround: unset REDWOOD_API_KEY and only set REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT or restart process after rotation. not viable for workers.
lee: I'll take a small SDK patch: change precedence to treat *_PROJECT env vars as higher priority and add a refreshIfStale() helper triggered on 401.token_invalid.
sam: suggestion for handler: on 401.token_invalid -> call credentials.refreshIfStale(); retry the request once; if still 401 then bubble up.
jordan: add CLI+SDK unit tests for precedence and an integration test that rotates a key mid-run.
token-rotator-bot: rotated key project:proj-42 at 2026-03-22T18:14:03Z :rotating_light:
maya: I'll open an issue with repro, short logs, and a minimal .env to attach. tagging @devex for triage.
